title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About The Job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration. You will represent the company in day-to-day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills. At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA,MC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market. Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What Your Day-to-day Would Look Like

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data-driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail-oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value-selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short-term disability insurances with SulAmerica
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
  • Open communication with management and company leadership
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels.

As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Visão geral

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte, e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO . Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. title: Senior Investment Analyst
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us! We are searching for a Senior Investment Analyst who will be responsible for research and analytical duties surrounding the Endowment and Retirement Trust. Outputs of analysis will include preparation of reporting materials such as asset allocation, evaluating performance of existing managers, preparation of cash balances and interaction with custodian. Howard University Investment Office is responsible for the management of the Endowment/Investment Pool and the Retirement Trust totaling an aggregated AUM over $1.6 billion in accordance with Board of Trustee approved investment policy and asset allocation. The University has benefited from tremendous leadership by the President and Senior Administration in attracting world-class students and faculty and positioning the University in the short and long-term. The growth in Endowment supports these efforts and the Retirement Trust funding ratio is the highest in its recent history. Senior Investment Analyst will be supportive of the Chief Investment and Deputy Chief Investment Officer, primarily accountable for ongoing performance analysis, documentation, and reporting activities of the Investment Office related to the selection, monitoring and oversight of the Endowment\'s external investment managers. This role is heavily involved in the office\'s data collection and retention process. In addition to working closely with members of the investment team, this role will interact with other University departments and external entities including the Endowment\'s investment managers and administrators, custodian bank, and auditors. The Senior Investment Operations Analyst will be responsible for producing high quality work, including material that is readily presentable to constituencies inside and outside of the Investment Office.

Nature And Scope

The investment portfolio invests in diversified asset classes including domestic and international equities, domestic and global bonds, Inflation Hedging and Alternative strategies such as hedge funds, private equity and real assets. The Endowment and Retirement Funds uses external investment managers through commingled vehicles, separate accounts, trusts and limited partnerships. Manager selection, diligence and asset class assumptions accomplished with assistance of consultants and other partners.

Operational

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Oversee with the CIO and DCIO, the investment portfolio and related projects including cash reconciliation, return and risk calculations, documentation requests, workflow details with Treasury.
  • Take ownership of pacing analysis and capital call adherence

Investment Operations For Risk Management And Performance Attribution

  • Responsible for the selection, development and maintenance of the analytics system for research management and investment performance attribution and risk management. Work with the Information Services Department as a partner, when appropriate
  • Work to ensure that all documents and contracts secure the rights and property of the University.

Administration

  • Help create materials for Investment Committee meetings
  • Participate, in a general sense, as a team member of the Howard University Investment Office.

Investment Research, Manager Due Diligence And Fund Selection

  • Evaluate current and recommend new investment managers
  • Perform statistical analysis and general research related to the capital markets for purposes of defining options for continuous investment improvements and recommendations for tactical strategies within asset classes to enhance performance of the overall portfolio
  • Analyze investment performance and investment related issues and prepare material for the CIO and presentations (verbal and written) to the Investment Committee.
  • Review all footnotes of all presentation materials of external manager investments
  • Review appropriateness of investment fees and costs and recommend reductions

Projects

  • Perform periodic studies, such as benchmarking on different investment issues, and manage projects as assigned.

Other Duties

  • As assigned

Core Competencies

  • Advanced excel modeling
  • Investment Banking or institutional finance training
  • Significant written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to deliver accurate deliverables
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently, identify problems, priorities, solutions
  • Knowledge of investment portfolio theory and process of manager evaluation and selection

Professional Development

  • Enhance professional growth by participating in educational programs and professional organizations and activities to maintain knowledge of national and international trends and to promote edge performance and expertise.
  • Attend conferences and seminars to enhance understanding of current operational issues, which impact portfolio and investment results. Network with other endowments and foundations to learn of investment programs, strategies and systems which may be applicable to Howard University.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a minimum of 10 years of endowment, foundation or investment experience; skills in both written and oral communication; knowledge of investment concepts in a broad range of asset classes. The ideal candidate would possess deep knowledge of equity and fixed income strategies, CFA designation, MBA in Finance, and experience in private markets would be preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $150,000 - $175,000

Your passion for open‑source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G and beyond. This role is a hands‑on role where you will both design and implement solutions.

Remote‑based, Americas

What your day will look like

  • Match customer requirements to advanced capabilities in the VNF/CNF/NFVi/NFVO/VNFM/VIM/MEC space

  • Design and implement telco‑grade open source multi‑tenant private clouds and micro clouds
  • Deploy cloud solutions for our customers (OpenStack, Kubernetes, MAAS and Ceph)

What we are looking for in you

  • Technical understanding of key telco technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SRIOV, DPDK, etc

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno | Botafogo/RJ
description:
Somos a Strattner

Desenvolvemos a saúde no Brasil, oferecendo inovações que importam, tanto para os nossos clientes, quanto para a sociedade.

Quem somos nós?

A Strattner é uma empresa familiar e brasileira que atua no mercado médico hospitalar desde 1950. Vamos além da tradição. Somos transformação, conhecimento, compartilhamento e dedicação.

Somos mais de 500 colaboradores preparados para levar qualidade e agilidade no atendimento de todos nossos clientes. E há 70 anos seguimos obstinados em viver o nosso propósito de desenvolver conhecimento e trazer inovação para antecipar o futuro da saúde.

A diversidade nos move para frente!

Desde o começo da nossa história, atuamos com valores que promovem um ambiente sempre aberto ao diálogo, onde todas as vozes são escutadas e respeitadas. Acreditamos que poder ser quem nós somos, do jeito que nos sentimos bem, nos ajuda na realização de um bom trabalho, além de criar um maior companheirismo no espaço corporativo e ter motivação para chegar mais longe. Queremos que todos aqui sejam reconhecidos pelo seu trabalho e que todos tenham as mesmas oportunidades. Nós somos diferentes, aceitamos, respeitamos e principalmente valorizamos isso.

Estamos prontos para crescer e assumir ainda mais desafios.

E você, quer fazer parte desta jornada?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente da construção do orçamento anual (Budget) e dos forecasts periódicos, atuando junto às áreas de negócio na definição de premissas financeiras e operacionais.
  • Atuar como Business Partner das áreas, apoiando gestores na leitura dos resultados, análise de desvios e avaliação do impacto financeiro das decisões operacionais.
  • Analisar mensalmente o resultado realizado vs orçamento vs forecast, identificando variações, drivers de performance e recomendações de ação.
  • Elaborar, analisar e consolidar informações gerenciais mensais, integrando dados financeiros e operacionais para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Preparar e consolidar relatórios financeiros e operacionais recorrentes, garantindo consistência, confiabilidade e aderência às necessidades das áreas internas.
  • Atuar no fechamento financeiro mensal, incluindo consolidação intercompany, assegurando qualidade dos dados, prazos e alinhamento com a contabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e apresentar relatórios e apresentações executivas de indicadores para diretoria, com foco em performance, tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Analisar custos e despesas (Opex e Capex), apoiando iniciativas de eficiência, controle orçamentário e melhoria de margens.
  • Identificar e propor melhorias de processos, relatórios e modelos financeiros, visando maior automação, padronização e eficiência analítica.
  • Apoiar o fechamento financeiro e as análises por meio do ERP (ex.: SAP) e ferramentas de BI, garantindo integridade e governança das informações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação concluída.
  • Inglês nível avançado.
  • Pacote Office avançado.
  • Nível de espanhol desejável.

Informações adicionais

A Strattner utilizará os dados pessoais fornecidos pelo candidato para fins exclusivos de processos seletivos, inclusive em bancos de vagas alocados em plataformas terceiras. Caso deseje solicitar oposição a este uso, ou exercer quaisquer um dos seus direitos, entre em contato através de nossos canais, disponíveis na Política de Privacidade da Strattner ( Não há necessidade de aceitar, trata-se apenas de uma ciência.

Ao participar do processo seletivo, o Candidato tem ciência que poderá acionar à Strattner, a qualquer momento, por meio do e-mail para exercer seus direitos, nos termos previsto no artigo 18 da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (Lei nº 13.709/2018).

title: MRV Researcher
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil — where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

ON SITE, HYBRID - Piracicaba. Language skills: advanced English + Portuguese.

The impact you can make

  • Advance cutting‑edge ERW research in tropical environments, contributing directly to global carbon dioxide removal efforts.
  • Strengthen and refine our experimental design, ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of our measurements.
  • Elevate the scientific quality of our field and laboratory work, influencing key decisions across the organization.
  • Support the development of innovative MRV approaches that shape the future of climate‑tech science.
  • Build meaningful partnerships with researchers, institutions, and collaborators who help accelerate our mission.

Core working relationships

  • MRV Manager & Soil Scientist – direct reporting line, close collaboration on scientific strategy and priorities.
  • MRV Researchers – daily collaboration on experimental design, data analysis, fieldwork, and knowledge sharing.
  • Field & Operations Teams – coordination for sampling, experiment setup, monitoring, and logistics.
  • Sample Inventory and Lab Teams – coordination of sample processing and analysis, effective prioritisation.
  • Data & Analytics Teams – support on data interpretation, modeling, and integration into MRV systems.
  • External Partners – engagement with universities, labs, farmers, and research collaborators to advance ERW knowledge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight and management of the onsite experiments in ESALQ (e.g. greenhouse experiments)
  • Oversee the scientific operations, such as design of experiments
  • Generate, analyse and manage data and samples related to our experiments
  • Ensure quality control checks are carried out on data generated and sample collection
  • Oversee sample inventory management and processing
  • Provide support and research to help the science team strategy moving forward
  • Compare, present and discuss data and research (e.g. recent papers) internally with our science team as well as with leading researchers globally
  • Available to deputise or cover for other members of the science team when they are away on leave or unable to carry out tasks
  • Available to support on field work and infield tasks
  • May lead on certain novel R&D topics related to EW

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

  • A PhD or at least a master’s degree in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry, or a related field.
  • Solid knowledge of geology and weathering processes in tropical soils.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Advanced English, sufficient to present and discuss research within an international team.
  • Residency in or near Piracicaba (SP), or willingness to relocate.
  • Experience ensuring data quality and working with large sets of samples.
  • A deep curiosity for the science behind ERW in tropical agricultural systems, and the ability to dive into details with rigor.
  • An independent, confident, hands‑on approach—proactive, energetic, and driven to make things happen.
  • A fast‑learning mindset, with the motivation to continuously develop both professionally and personally.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex scientific problems and communicate them clearly and concisely.
  • A collaborative spirit—you enjoy working with others, supporting the team, and actively stepping in when needed.
  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Key qualities

  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Bonus points (not required)

  • Experience with greenhouse experiments, lysimeters, or soil analyses.
  • Knowledge of carbon removal methodologies or MRV frameworks.
  • Prior experience in tropical agriculture or working with field‑based experiments.
  • Familiarity with analytical equipment, geochemical modeling, or hydrology.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget.
  • Personal development budget.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV‑screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation).
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies).
  • Optional third interview.
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed).
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling.
  • Offer.

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese). It may apply to a range of working relationships, including full‑time or part‑time employment as well as independent contractor or service‑based arrangements, depending on the candidate's location and compliance framework. Each engagement is carefully assessed on a case‑by‑case basis to ensure alignment with applicable laws and InPlanet’s global operating standards.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.

Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.

With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.

If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do:

  • Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas through a solid, measurable sales process while conducting detailed and professional sales campaigns;
  • Build a pipeline of new clients through heavy prospecting and networking within the Corporate & FSP sectors;
  • Build and maintain effective client relationships, and strategically navigate to identify and close up & cross-sell expansion business;
  • Develop deep insights regarding customer use cases, internal decision-making nuances, budget cycles, and other key information;
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the value of Magnet Forensics’ portfolio of solutions;
  • Solution Selling by prescribing positive business outcome(s) to the customer’s current business problem(s);
  • Facilitate technical product demonstrations alongside a team of supporting Solution Consultants and manage product trial lifecycle;
  • Expand new and mature existing channel partner relationships to extend reach and accelerate new business growth;
  • Accurately forecast the state of the region weekly, fully leverage Magnet’s complete Sales tech stack, and maintain complete and accurate records of all sales activities in Magnet’s systems.

*Note: Travel is a part of this role and could be expected up to 30% of the time.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience selling software in a fast-paced, competitive market;
  • A track record of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets – in both direct and channel capacities ;
  • The ability to expand the scope of an opportunity at a strategic and tactical level, and utilize appropriate resources to execute successfully;
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process, buying process, and business drivers for enterprise clients;
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn new business and technical concepts quickly.

*Fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English

Nice to Have Skills

  • Sales background in DFIR (Digital Forensics) and/or Cybersecurity arena;

What We Are Looking For

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have ‘been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.

How We Work

At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.

We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

The Most Important Thing

We’re looking for candidates that can provide examples of how they have demonstrated Magnet CODE in their previous experiences:

CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.

OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

DEDICATE – We put our heart and soul into meeting the needs of our customers and helping them serve the people they protect.

EVOLVE – We are constantly innovating and exploring new ways to work together to make an impact with our work.

Here at Magnet Forensics, we are committed to continuous learning and are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. This commitment will be reflected in our hiring processes and embedded in our values and how we treat one another. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet all of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Magnet Forensics is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and work environment. Accommodation is available to all applicants upon request throughout the hiring process. Please contact should you require any accommodations.

All offers of employment at Magnet are contingent upon satisfactory completion of a background check. All background checks will be conducted in accordance with all applicable laws. Magnet will consider each position’s job duties, among other factors, in determining what constitutes satisfactory completion of the background check. Refusal to consent to a background check may be grounds for revoking an offer of employment.

US Applicants: Magnet Forensics participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Magnet Forensics handles and uses personal data of job applicants in line with its Recruitment Privacy Policy found here.

Benefícios

Temos Paixão por aprender e pensando no seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos diversos cursos na nossa Universidade HEINEKEN, além de parcerias educacionais e programa de idiomas*.

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN!

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso team, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. Acreditamos no nosso #timedeestrelas e oferecemos um ambiente leve, informal e respeitoso para que todas as nossas pessoas se sintam confortáveis para ser quem são e, dessa forma, sejam protagonistas de suas carreiras. title: Analista de Crédito
description:
Job description

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar de forma analítica e estratégica na avaliação de risco de crédito, por meio da análise aprofundada de demonstrações financeiras, entendimento da dinâmica operacional e setorial dos clientes, leitura do cenário macroeconômico e das condições de mercado, assegurando decisões de crédito alinhadas à sustentabilidade financeira, rentabilidade e mitigação de riscos da Betunel.

Main responsibilities

Realizar análise econômico-financeira completa dos clientes, com leitura crítica de balanços patrimoniais, demonstrações de resultados, fluxo de caixa, endividamento, estrutura de capital, liquidez, rentabilidade e capacidade de geração de caixa;

Avaliar a capacidade de pagamento e de execução operacional dos clientes, considerando histórico de adimplência, carteira de contratos/obras, perfil de recebíveis (especialmente públicos), concentração de risco, garantias e exposição global de crédito;

Analisar o posicionamento do cliente no mercado, seu setor de atuação, nível de competitividade, dependência de contratos públicos ou privados, ciclo do negócio e sensibilidade a variações econômicas;

Monitorar o cenário macroeconômico e setorial (juros, inflação, crédito, investimentos em infraestrutura, orçamento público, funding bancário), avaliando impactos diretos na capacidade financeira dos clientes e no risco da carteira;

Calcular e revisar limites e necessidades de crédito com base na programação de vendas, volumes contratados, preços, exposição já concedida, garantias existentes e perfil de risco;

Propor atualizações na Política de Crédito, considerando mudanças econômicas, regulatórias, práticas de mercado, custos financeiros, execução de garantias e estratégias da concorrência;

Estruturar, aprimorar e operacionalizar modelos de análise de crédito, critérios de rating, segmentação de risco e instrumentos de mitigação;

Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de risco (aging, concentração, exposição, inadimplência, comportamento de pagamento);

Contribuir para a automação das análises, segurança das informações e uso de ferramentas analíticas e dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Econômicas, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas,
  • Conhecimento da dinâmica de diferentes fontes de recursos (capital próprio, crédito bancário, recebíveis, contratos públicos).
  • Conhecimento em análise de balanços, DRE, fluxo de caixa e indicadores financeiros;
  • Conhecimento em finanças corporativas e matemática financeira;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de análise de crédito e gestão de risco;

Sobre Nós

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição.

Com 14 Centros de Distribuição e uma equipe de mais de 9.000 colaboradores, atuamos desde a negociação até a entrega de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias em todo o país.

Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

Join to apply for the Professor(a) de História IB (BSS) - Ensino Médio - Barra da Tijuca/RJ role at Escola Eleva

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de História IB (BSS) - Ensino Médio. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de História IB (BSS) alinhadas com currículo IB, com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em História;
  • Experiência com Ensino Médio;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência prévia com o currículo IB;
  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Generative AI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills.

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

  • You hold a Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering.

  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

Professor(a) de Creative e Tech - Botafogo/RJ

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, BR

Neste papel você será nosso(a) Professor(a) de Creative Tech. Procuramos alguém com paixão e curiosidade pelo universo de tecnologia e de educação, que tenha experiência com planejamento e execução de aulas para crianças e jovens.

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;

  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;

  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

  • Diploma de licenciatura em Pedagogia, Design, Artes ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência com ensino.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: MRV Researcher
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. The company is scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast.

Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil, where the real climate impact happens.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight and management of the onsite experiments in ESALQ (e.g. greenhouse experiments)
  • You oversee the scientific operations, such as design of experiments
  • You generate, analyse and manage data and samples related to our experiments
  • You ensure quality control checks are carried out on data generated and sample collection
  • You oversee sample inventory management and processing
  • You provide support and research to help the science team strategy moving forward
  • You compare, present and discuss data and research (e.g. recent papers) internally with our (science) team as well as with leading researchers globally
  • You are available to deputise or cover for other members of the science team when they are away on leave or unable to carry out tasks
  • You are available to support on field work and infield tasks
  • You may lead on certain novel R+D topics related to EW

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

  • A PhD or at least a master’s degree in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry, or a related field.
  • Solid knowledge of geology and weathering processes in tropical soils.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Advanced English, sufficient to present and discuss research within an international team.
  • Residency in or near Piracicaba (SP), or willingness to relocate.
  • Experience ensuring data quality and working with large sets of samples
  • A deep curiosity for the science behind ERW in tropical agricultural systems, and the ability to dive into details with rigor.
  • An independent, confident, hands‑on approach—proactive, energetic, and driven to make things happen.
  • A fast‑learning mindset, with the motivation to continuously develop both professionally and personally.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex scientific problems and communicate them clearly and concisely.
  • A collaborative spirit—you enjoy working with others, supporting the team, and actively stepping in when needed.

Key qualities

  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Bonus points (not required)

  • Experience with greenhouse experiments, lysimeters, or soil analyses.
  • Knowledge of carbon removal methodologies or MRV frameworks.
  • Prior experience in tropical agriculture or working with field‑based experiments.
  • Familiarity with analytical equipment, geochemical modeling, or hydrology.

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Language skills: advanced English + Portuguese

As our MRV Researcher , you will lead research on Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical soils, with a particular focus on soil analyses. You will design, execute, and manage experiments that accurately monitor carbon dioxide removal, ensuring scientific rigor and high‑quality data. You will take full ownership of our on‑site experiments, drive improvements, and help shape our scientific strategy for ERW.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the entire science team, supporting and contributing to all experiments and in‑field monitoring activities. You will also engage with internal and external stakeholders, strengthening relationships that advance our research goals.

You will report directly to our MRV Manager & Soil Scientist, Mariane , and work alongside a multidisciplinary group of dedicated and ambitious MRV researchers. Your week may take you between the lab, the field, our on‑site experiments, the greenhouse, visits to ESALQ and ESALQTEC, or focused work from home—always within a collaborative and high‑trust environment.

The impact you can make

  • Advance cutting‑edge ERW research in tropical environments, contributing directly to global carbon dioxide removal efforts.
  • Strengthen and refine our experimental design, ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of our measurements.
  • Elevate the scientific quality of our field and laboratory work, influencing key decisions across the organization.
  • Support the development of innovative MRV approaches that shape the future of climate‑tech science.
  • Build meaningful partnerships with researchers, institutions, and collaborators who help accelerate our mission.

Core working relationships

  • MRV Manager & Soil Scientist – direct reporting line, close collaboration on scientific strategy and priorities.
  • MRV Researchers – daily collaboration on experimental design, data analysis, fieldwork, and knowledge sharing.
  • Field & Operations Teams – coordination for sampling, experiment setup, monitoring, and logistics.
  • Sample Inventory and Lab Teams – coordination of sample processing and analysis, effective prioritisation.
  • Data & Analytics Teams – support on data interpretation, modeling, and integration into MRV systems.
  • External Partners – engagement with universities, labs, farmers, and research collaborators to advance ERW knowledge.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.

These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV‑screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

To hear about updates on future opportunities, please follow us on LinkedIn. To keep up with InPlanet market updates, subscribe to our Newsletter.

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanetunless it is justified to be in Portuguese). This job description is intended to provide a clear summary of the responsibilities, scope, and expectations associated with this opportunity. It may apply to a range of working relationships, including full‑time or part‑time employment as well as independent contractor or service‑based arrangements, depending on the candidate's location and compliance framework. Each engagement is carefully assessed on a case‑by‑case basis to ensure alignment with applicable laws and InPlanet’s global operating standards.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: Freelance Accounting Consultant - AI Trainer
description:
At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking curious and intellectually proactive contributors who double‑check assumptions and play devil’s advocate, comfortable with ambiguity and complexity. This flexible, project‑based opportunity is ideal for analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills, and for those open to a part‑time, non‑permanent role.

About the Project

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise. You’ll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version to train the agent to succeed with less hand‑holding. Real expert complexity only – you’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you have the relevant experience and are ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

How to Get Started

Apply to this post to contribute to projects aligned with your skills on your own schedule. To begin working in production, you’ll need to complete a qualification step and project onboarding, where you’ll become familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll directly shape how useful these models become for your future work.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Accounting, Auditing, Financial Accounting, or closely aligned areas
  • Professional industry experience in accounting with a minimum of three years in relevant fields (e.g., audit, financial reporting, internal controls, tax, management accounting). Experience in cross‑functional, applied, or international projects is an advantage.
  • Having a chartered accountancy qualification such as CPA, ACCA, or ICAEW is an advantage
  • Familiarity with U.S. GAAP standards
  • Ability to write clearly and professionally, including explaining complex tasks in simple, structured language
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources and turn it into accurate, coherent outputs
  • Creativity in designing realistic and engaging examples, cases, or workflows based on your domain knowledge
  • Proven ability to use English fluently in professional settings, written and verbal (C1/C2 level)
  • Access to a laptop, stable internet connection, and sufficient availability to engage with project tasks
  • Motivation to work with challenging, complex, but well‑defined guidelines, learn new methods, and strengthen domain‑specific skills

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $16 hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Responsibilities

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the “Control Room” and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.

Desired Profile

Must Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.

  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.

  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

Why You’re Here

You’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.

You’re here to:

  • Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping.
  • Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content.
  • Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross-channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences.
  • AI-Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale.
  • Channel Identification: Build presence in ecosystems like Reddit, Hackernews, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, X, dev.to, substack, and emerging platforms (which you’ll need to identify).
  • Social Media & Community: Manage Zyte’s social presence with an eye for authenticity and cutting-edge social plays.
  • Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs.

Quantitative

  • New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)
  • Content engagement (CTR, CVR, downloads, shares)

Qualitative

  • Innovation in AI-driven content repurposing
  • Speed and creativity of campaign execution
  • Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content
  • Cross-team collaboration and impact on broader demand gen goals

Who You Are

  • Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.
  • Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery.
  • AI-Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.
  • Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.
  • Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.

Requirements

  • 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products
  • Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills
  • Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.
  • (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer tools

Tech You’ll work with

  • HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics
  • Figma, Notion, Google Workspace
  • ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideation

How We Work

We move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

Venha crescer com a gente!

Missão do cargo:

Estabelecer políticas, estratégias e diretrizes da disciplina de Engenharia de Confiabilidade de Manutenção das instalações e equipamentos por meio da implementação de metodologias de Engenharia de Confiabilidade e dos planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva a fim de garantir e maximizar a confiabilidade, disponibilidade, manutenção, segurança e integridade dos ativos no ciclo de vida útil, dando atendimento aos objetivos de custos, produtividade, qualidade e segurança, assim como a preservação do meio ambiente de acordo com as políticas da COMPANHIA e conformidade legal aplicável.

Main responsibilities

  1. Dar suporte técnico nas diferentes etapas dos Projetos (Engenharia Conceitual, Básica e Detalhada) para garantir a confiabilidade e disponibilidade das instalações, equipamentos e sistemas inerentes ao Projeto, aplicando metodologias e estudos de Engenharia de Confiabilidade;
  2. Estabelecer as políticas, estratégias e programas de Engenharia de Confiabilidade para otimizar os planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, garantindo a confiabilidade de equipamentos e instalações através de uma relação custo-risco-beneficio positiva na gestão de ativos;
  3. Desenvolver e implementar metodologias de análise para determinar a confiabilidade e disponibilidade das instalações, componentes, equipamentos e sistemas;
  4. Realizar análise de problemas operacionais para minimizar falhas ou paradas não programadas que tenham impacto na continuidade operacional, segurança e confiabilidade para atingir os objetivos estabelecidos, além de suportar a implementação de técnicas de manutenção preditiva, padrões de gestão, análise de falhas, melhorias de projetos e melhores práticas de planejamento e controle de manutenção. Cumprindo com os objetivos de custos, produtividade, qualidade e segurança, assim como a preservação do meio ambiente de acordo com as políticas da Companhia e conformidade legal aplicável;
  5. Suportar tecnicamente na implementação das metodologias de: Análise de Criticidade de Ativos, Confiabilidade, Análise de Disponibilidade e Manutenibilidade, Metodologia para Desenho de Planos de Inspeção Baseados em Riscos, Metodologia para Solução de Problemas Baseada em Análise de Causa Raiz, Estudos de Custo Risco - Benefício, Análise Econômica do Ciclo de Vida dos Ativos, Manutenção Centrada em Confiabilidade, Análises de efeito e modos de falhas, para otimizar as estratégias e planos de inspeção e manutenção;
  6. Elaborar recomendações técnicas ou planos de ação a fim de atender as necessidades da Operação por meio do alinhamento com a gestão técnica e suporte de manutenção;
  7. Realizar avaliações técnicas dos processos de planejamento, programação, inspeção e manutenção por meio de auditorias técnicas para garantir o cumprimento dos planos estabelecidos, objetivos da Companhia e obrigações legais aplicáveis. Suportar o planejamento orçamentário anual (despesas e investimentos) para a disciplina sob responsabilidade, fornecendo informações baseadas em experiências anteriores, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas do mercado;
  8. Participar e / ou elaborar padrões corporativos como parte do Sistema de Gestão Integrado, bem como a geração dos relatórios e notas técnicas inerentes ao cargo para preservar o conhecimento dentro da Organização contribuindo com os objetivos de qualidade, custo e produção de óleo e gás. Assegurar que as estratégias de manutenção sejam implementadas nas rotinas da frota em conformidade com as diretrizes da Companhia e órgãos reguladores;
  9. Contribuir para a governança do CMMS atualizando e monitorando informações sobre hierarquia, descrição de trabalho, plano de inspeção e manutenção. Monitorar os KPIs das barreiras de segurança de processos e fornecer recomendação técnica, quando necessário, a fim de garantir a eficácia dos processos e manter a operação da instalação dentro do nível ALARP;
  10. Garantir a comunicação e o alinhamento com a equipe nas Operações e apoiar suas necessidades, a fim de alcançar conformidade com os planos de inspeção e manutenção.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação acadêmica: Engenharia Mecânica, Metalúrgica, de Materiais, Petróleo, Industrial ou áreas correlatas, com mínimo de 7 anos de experiência na especialidade .
  • Experiência em Engenharia de Confiabilidade , incluindo:
    • Análises de causa-raiz;
    • Análise de modos e efeitos de falhas (FMEA/FMECA);
    • Análise de criticidade de ativos;
    • Manutenção centrada em confiabilidade (RCM);
    • Estudos de custo-risco-benefício;
    • Análise de disponibilidade e manutenibilidade;
    • Análise econômica do ciclo de vida dos ativos;
    • Elaboração de planos de inspeção baseados em risco.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de normas e regulamentações : ASME, ANSI, ISO, OSHAS 18000, Normas Técnicas Brasileiras e demais legislações aplicáveis.
  • Inglês avançado – capacidade de se comunicar verbalmente e por escrito em reuniões de negócios, debates técnicos, elaboração e apresentação de relatórios e seminários.
  • Domínio de ferramentas e softwares de análise estatística de dados para confiabilidade e manutenção.

VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

E os nossos benefícios?

Para sua saúde e bem-estar

  • Assistência Médica de plano hospitalar com obstetrícia para todos os níveis hierárquicos e cobertura de todos os procedimentos no rol da ANS (Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar –
  • Dr. Be (telemedicina, telepsicologia, coaching nutricional e coaching esportivo) sem custo para o colaborador e seus dependentes;

Para facilitar o seu dia a dia

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Convênio com restaurantes;
  • Cartão de crédito multicompras;
  • Desconto de Colaborador de até 20% para compras de produtos nas nossas lojas Renner, Youcom, Ashua e Camicado.

Para sua flexibilidade e rotina

  • Metodologia Balance aplicada junto à liderança e time fortalecendo a comunicação e reconhecimento, bem-estar e estilo de trabalho/ferramentas.

Conheça nossa Ser (Associação dos Colaboradores Renner S.A.)

Fundado em 1986 a Ser promove e impulsiona ações voltadas ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento social e cultural. Os colaboradores sócios contam com serviços diferenciados, clube de descontos e vantagens com mais de 200 empresas parceiras nas áreas de educação, saúde, alimentação, lazer e entretenimento. Veja nossos principais convênios!

  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Desconto em farmácias de até 35%;
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Ingressos de cinemas e muito mais.

Pessoas com deficiência são bem‑vindas em todas as nossas oportunidades.

  • Entrevista Gestor

Sobre a Lojas Renner

O que é que te encanta?

Muito além da maior varejista de moda do país, somos um Ecossistema no qual criamos o futuro, inovamos e solucionamos diferentes desafios. Todos os dias aprendemos algo novo, desenvolvemos habilidades e aprimoramos talentos. Aqui, temos o sentimento de pertencimento, respeitamos o diverso e trabalhamos em um ambiente no qual cuidamos e somos cuidados. Nossa consciência ambiental e social está presente em todas as ações, pois temos compromisso claro com os colaboradores, clientes e fornecedores. Juntos, levamos Encantamento às mais de 600 lojas nos cinco estados do Brasil, além de Argentina e Uruguai.

Se o que te encanta é poder aprender, compartilhar e ensinar. Se o que te encanta é o respeito, a diversidade e a inclusão. Seu lugar é aqui.

Junte-se ao time de 24 mil colaboradores que estão reunidos para encantar ao lado das marcas Renner, Camicado, Youcom, Ashua, Repassa e Realize.

E aí, vem fazer moda responsável com a gente?
